name: Seven-stage evidence filter, independent of 12 knowledge domains
scope: Research-only. This file is not evidence of trading validity.
always_on: D10 Data integrity at every measurable stage
D11 Nulls, counterevidence and negative cases at every empirical claim
Unknown/insufficient data cannot become negative evidence or PASS
No source-borrowed claim may be promoted to profit signal

gates.name: 问题与决策时点
gates.rejection: If objective is undefined, research only; do not infer a trading action.
gates.continuation: Define what needs explaining/predicting/executing and the information available at the decision.

gates.name: 相关知识与来源定位
gates.rejection: Keyword miss -> SOURCE_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED, not scientific falsehood.
gates.continuation: Select narrowly useful domains and optionally related context; preserve competing sources.

gates.name: 事实与数据质量
gates.rejection: Missing/late/unverified evidence -> INSUFFICIENT for factual or predictive conclusions.
gates.continuation: Use strict as-of cutoff, exclude future labels, separate missing/zero and re-query original Solana events.

gates.name: 结构机制及替代解释
gates.rejection: Wallet linkage without exclusion of common services does not establish control or intent.
gates.continuation: Distinguish correlation, funding association, economic control and actual identity.

gates.name: 预测增量与外部有效性
gates.rejection: Structural detection or in-sample hit rate alone -> no predictive assertion.
gates.continuation: Test only features observable at decision time; compare against simpler baselines and OOS.

gates.name: 可交易性与正净期望
gates.rejection: Peak price and 2x hit rate are not a viable copy trade.
gates.continuation: Evaluate executable entry/exit and expected net returns under varied sizes and failure scenarios.

gates.name: 发布、漂移与回滚
gates.rejection: Unreviewed or externally reported research cannot change the monitor.
gates.continuation: Limit this project to read-only/paper-only until separately authorized and validated.
